title: Monotone learning degree
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a rational parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, define the monotone learning degree by applying the degree-from-total-influence rule to the total influence of majority on $n$ coordinates and parameter $\varepsilon$.
